arStrings.szText: {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}Each Damage over Time type you apply explodes every second, dealing {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[(Owner.Weapon_Damage_Min_Total + Owner.Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total) * (1 + Owner.Main_Hand_Damage_Percent_Bonus) * Affix_Value_1]{/c} damage over {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds to surrounding enemies.{if:SF.IsMythic}{/c_mythic}{/if}
